structured_output.what_is_happening: "Betty" launched about 11 minutes ago as a PumpSwap pool created directly, not a pump.fun curve graduate: migrated_unix is 0, and the pool appeared 4 seconds after the mint. Liquidity (~$52.7k) is larger than market cap (~$33.8k), and the pool holds 77.8% of supply. The LP is 100% unlocked and the creator's account is closed. Volume is ~$72k in the first hour, with 1,126 unique buyers against only 115 sellers, and price is up ~33–47%. The same-name list shows at least 8 other "Betty" tokens created in the past ~5 hours. All of them now have liquidity of $0 or $0.01 but still show stale market caps of $33k–$287k. Two of them (Has9…, Cu2u…) were created only 20–30 minutes before this one and had big hourly volume before their liquidity went to zero. That fits a serial liquidity-pull operation that keeps relaunching the same ticker.

narrative.description: Generic name ticker ('Betty'), possibly riding some trending Betty meme or person. No website, socials, description or DexScreener profile.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely it isn't spreading organically. The flow of buyers probably comes from launch-feed and volume-scanner bots, plus whatever made 'Betty' a name worth cloning today. The packet shows no organic story.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is simply the latest of many same-name clones and has no socials that would make it the canonical one.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 8 'Betty' tokens from today, all with liquidity pulled ($0 or $0.01), including two launched 20–30 minutes earlier that had $50k–$150k of hourly volume. There are also older Betty Boop tokens.

authenticity.evidence: Direct PumpSwap pool with dev-supplied LP that is 100% unlocked. Liquidity is larger than market cap. The creator account is closed. GMGN flags 10 bundler wallets, and one wallet holds 10.55%. The earlier same-name tokens show the same pattern and have all had their liquidity drained within hours. 1,126 unique buyers in about 15 minutes for a token with no socials looks like many small wallets or bots.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN reports 0 fresh wallets and a 0 bot/degen rate, which could mean the buyers are real retail traders. From the packet alone I can't prove the earlier clones share this deployer.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked and held by whoever created the pool, so it can be pulled at any time
Same-ticker clones launched in the past few hours have all had their liquidity pulled
Creator account is closed, so dev history can't be traced
One wallet holds 10.55% of supply, and GMGN flags 10 bundler wallets

structured_output.counterargument: Mint and freeze authority are renounced, and top-10 holders own only ~12.7%. Buyers outnumber sellers about 10:1, GMGN shows zero fresh or sniper wallets, and there are no paid boosts. With real-looking breadth and a deep $52k pool at a $34k market cap, a real rush of demand on a trending name could double the price quickly, possibly before any liquidity pull. Earlier clones also reached $160k–$290k market caps before dying, so a 2x from $34k is within the pattern's range if the pull comes late.
unknowns: Whether this token has the same deployer or LP provider as the rugged Betty clones

structured_output.thesis: This looks like the latest round of a serial same-ticker liquidity-pull farm: a direct PumpSwap pool with unlocked, dev-supplied liquidity, a closed creator account, and 8 same-name tokens from today all drained. A liquidity pull within 6 hours is the most likely outcome. A +100% move before the pull is possible but unlikely, so this should rank low.
